    "Consolidated multi-channel communication (email, SMS, WhatsApp) in one platform",

    "Effective contact management, segmentation, and personalization features"

    "Data import/export can be cumbersome, especially with custom fields",

  "overall_experience": "The IT Operations Coordinator found Brevo to be a valuable tool for centralizing communication channels and managing contacts efficiently. They appreciated the straightforward setup process for core functionalities like transactional emails and domain authentication, which is crucial for their role. While the platform offered good value and functionality for their small hospitality business, they encountered some frustrations with data handling, particularly around importing/exporting and maintaining list hygiene."
